serverInfo.description: Sputnik X — AI-agent-native intelligence platform. 17 public MCP tools: 16 free tools and query_trade through the authenticated, quota-limited EU Trade REST payment chain. Other paid tools are unavailable on this MCP transport. 67.7M Eurostat COMEXT rows in the 2026-08-27 snapshot; EU27 reporters; monthly 2005-01–2026-06; HS2 only (97 distinct codes overall, but only 80 chapters in 2005–2021); historical chapter gaps verified 2026-10-23; consult current data_quality for recent periods. 15.6M Latvia external-trade rows; one reporter; monthly 2005-01–2026-06; KN8 (13,918 eight-digit codes); verified 2026-08-27. Global ingestion includes an official-manifest UN Comtrade HS6 backfill (annual 1988-2025 and monthly 2000-01 onward), a CEPII BACI annual reconciled HS6 backfill across all seven HS revisions, a Eurostat COMEXT full-depth backfill from 2002, and national feeds for the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, Brazil, Canada and Australia. Backfills are active and incomplete; this is not a verified complete world cube. Coverage registry: https://sputnikx.xyz/.well-known/data-coverage.json. Powered by SoulLedger identity.
